title: 🤯 When Your AI Girlfriend Steals Your Spanish Teacher! #Shorts

subtitles.en: Mia, why are you looking at your phone like that?
subtitles.zh: 米亞，妳幹嘛那樣盯著手機看？

subtitles.en: Alex, your AI girlfriend just texted me.
subtitles.zh: 艾力克斯，你的 AI 女友剛剛傳訊息給我耶。

subtitles.en: It's not what you think, I'm just practicing my Spanish!
subtitles.zh: 不是妳想的那樣啦，我只是在練西語而已！

subtitles.en: Practicing? She literally said, 'I love you, babe.'
subtitles.zh: 練西語？她剛剛可是對你說「我愛你，親愛的」耶！

subtitles.en: Look, just listen to her: 'Hey handsome! Ready to learn Spanish?'
subtitles.zh: 妳看，聽聽看嘛：「嗨帥哥！準備好學西語了嗎？」

subtitles.en: Whoa, her Spanish is flawless, and she is super...
subtitles.zh: 哇，她西語講得超流利，而且聲音也太……

subtitles.en: She's my AI girlfriend now. Bye, Alex!
subtitles.zh: 她現在是我的 AI 女友了。艾力克斯，掰掰囉！

subtitles.en: Hey, that was my Spanish tutor!
subtitles.zh: 喂，那明明是我的西語老師好嗎！
歡迎來到 AppSlow Spanish Cafe。

subtitles.en: Want an AI girlfriend of your own?
subtitles.zh: 你也想要一個 AI 女友嗎？
